limitations: Accepting the image payload does not establish causal visual understanding.
RAM and image track are different observation contracts and must have separate results.
Do not trim observations differently by model; fit the common observation budget, and fail oversize requests explicitly.
Dated identity pinning is checked against actual returned model; Clef and Clef Flash have no dated identity in the catalogue.
Workers AI Clef/Clef Flash can silently truncate state text at roughly 2000 tokens; this manifest selects PrimeIntellect instead.
API availability and provider metadata can change; snapshot and audit the actual provider/model for every run.
Full observation consumption and RAM/image equivalence have not been causally verified for any contender. Clef Omni has documented remaining-context truncation, not a documented2000-token state cap.

readiness.selection_criterion: Technical native contract compatibility only; no gameplay score or latency threshold.
readiness.observation_equivalence: Not causally verified for any model; fourteen means selected-provider native image contract passed, with no known model-specific truncation under current documented limits.

input_contract_notes.common_observation_budget: Use identical observations, rules, questions, history and screenshot processing for all models within each track. Validate total provider-specific token budget; no model-specific evidence truncation.
input_contract_notes.image_common_format: One top-level native image_url state part with base64 lossless 512x480 PNG; native256x240 nearest-neighbour2x; plain strings for text parts.
input_contract_notes.paired_image_requirement: Use the same provider endpoint and state contract in RAM and image runs. Image HTTP success alone does not demonstrate visual grounding.
input_contract_notes.provider_text_truncation: Workers AI Clef/Clef Flash silently reads only roughly first2000 state-text tokens. Main RAM pins PrimeIntellect; alternate Cloudflare image passes remain unpaired and ineligible for paired image track.
input_contract_notes.provider_text_truncation_scope: OpenRouter documents roughly2000 state-text truncation for Workers Clef/ClefFlash only. Official Omni docs instead truncate state to remaining64Kcontext after questions/media. All providers still require common input budgeting; API success alone does not prove complete consumption.
